causes: The account-owned session awaits the initial window read. During loading the real transcript (manageSelection=false) restores a stored anchor by selecting the same conversation again. This cancels the old read; its future completes before the replacement page. The session used to interpret the replacement loading state as history_preparing.

openConversation and initialize copied that session read failure into _selectionError. Ready pages could republish the document and subsequent polls clear session.error, but the copied account error persisted and canSend stayed false. A genuine server preparing response followed by ready data reproduced the same persistent latch.

Window navigation during an in-flight related refresh discarded its scheduling signal. The session now coalesces that signal and rechecks the current window after refresh completion using the existing read budget.

A blank unassigned composer called reset on the newly selected saved draft before hydration. This counted as an edit, suppressed the stored text and could save an empty replacement. Only nonempty unassigned text is now adopted as an edit.
